description:

Beautifully framed by attractive, manicured gardens to both the front and rear, this home arrives on the market in excellent condition throughout, offering a true turn-key opportunity for discerning buyers seeking the ultimate family lifestyle. Internally, we have a bright and expansive layout designed for effortless modern living and entertaining. The ground floor boasts two generous reception rooms filled with natural light, flowing into an open-plan kitchen and dining area that serves as the heart of the home. A spacious utility room and a practical downstairs W.C. add to the seamless functionality of the property. Upstairs, the home features four well appointed bedrooms, including master en-suite, alongside a contemporary family bathroom. Adding to its many features, a brand-new metal deck outdoor room offering leisure and entertainment space perfectly suited for hosting gatherings.
